europe_now.title: France Braces for Protests and Security Measures Amid Nationwide Riots
europe_now.summary: France is preparing for further weekend protests and heightened security following a wave of nationwide riots and civil unrest. The government has announced a massive police deployment to manage upcoming demonstrations and address public safety.

sources.headline: France braces for another weekend of protests amid nationwide riots

europe_now.title: Italy Deploys Military and Enhances Security Laws Following Civil Unrest
europe_now.summary: Italy has deployed military troops into major urban areas such as Milan and approved tougher anti-riot laws to control recent violent demonstrations. These security enhancements reflect a broader government response to escalating public disorder across the nation.

sources.headline: Italy deploys troops into Milan in response to recent riots

top_stories.title: US Envoy Engages in Diplomatic Talks in Russia and Ukraine
top_stories.summary: US special envoy Steve Witkoff has held high-level discussions with officials in Russia and Ukraine regarding ongoing security developments. During these diplomatic engagements, American citizen Stephen Hubbard was released from Russian custody.

sources.headline: US citizen Stephen Hubbard freed by Russia as Trump envoy meets Putin
Ukraine talks: US envoy meets Vladimir Putin in Russia

top_stories.title: European Parliament Offices Targeted in Financial Mismanagement Probe
top_stories.summary: Prosecutors have conducted searches at the offices of a far-right group within the European Parliament. The operation is part of an ongoing investigation into allegations of EU funds mismanagement.

sources.headline: Prosecutor searches far-right group offices in EU Parliament
